entry.title: Alternaria toxins found to be genotoxic

entry.title: Nestlé transforms tube feeding with direct connect nutrition
entry.summary: Nestlé has launched Compleat Bolus Blends, a nutritionally complete plant-based tube feeding range designed to simplify bolus feeding through a direct-to-tube connection, reducing spills and handling while improving convenience for patients and caregivers. Available in age-specific formulas and made with over 50% fruit and vegetables, the launch strengthens Nestlé’s growing medical nutrition portfolio and focus on practical healthcare innovation.

entry.title: How wide is the GLP-1 halo?
entry.summary: The GLP-1 halo effect, where consumers follow diets similar to those of GLP-1 users without taking the drugs, is highly influential on consumer demand. In fact, suggests Kline and Company, the halo is far larger than the drugs' actual user base.

entry.title: What does the new unfair trading practices regulation mean for food?
entry.summary: In food and agriculture, smaller players, particularly farmers, often have far less bargaining power than larger companies. A directive on unfair trading practices in the EU aimed to change that. The Unfair Trading Practices Regulation sets out to improve enforcement of this directive, making cross-border enforcement in particular easier.
